plan.description: `null` when the project has no adopted repository.

steps.description: What the bootstrap WOULD DO. An empty list = the repository is already how the template wants it, and there is nothing to approve.

actionType.description: The same taxonomy as `proposed_actions` — each approved step becomes a recorded action when the bootstrap runs.

payload.description: The mutation data: which branch, which file, from where.

diagnostics.description: The divergences between the repository and the template.

kind.description: `extra_branch` is INFORMATIONAL and never blocks: an adopted repository has whatever policy it has, and the bootstrap doesn't delete it.

decision.description: `null` = plan generated and NOT yet decided. This is the state in which nothing runs (RN-045).

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
